answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because opal only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, fable is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any ember approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
